review: Independent read-only navigation metadata prewarming review and counterexample regression

method.execution: python -B with production source loaded by PowerShell into memory; mocked Kodi, cache and transport boundaries. Selected production functions/classes were compiled from AST where their module imports would initialize unrelated services. Network connection creation was forbidden in fixtures. A bounded child independently exercised real navigation.prepare, related_movies discovery, localized-season loading and the warm/tick chain.
method.implementation_owner: Main agent made fixes; reviewer only reported defects and reran independent fixtures.

verdict: The reproduced cancellation, retry-cooldown, invalid-success and shared-preloader gating counterexamples are blocked in the reviewed final snapshot. This is local semantic evidence, not device certification or proof of hard-real-time cancellation.

findings_and_regressions.initial_finding: TV and movie guards used only current request_remaining. A transport exception carrying metadata_stage=CANCELLED after the dynamic cancellation predicate returned to false was persisted as a 20-second failure, suppressing the next ordinary foreground fetch.
findings_and_regressions.control: When cancellation remains true, both original and fixed guards write no failure marker.

findings_and_regressions.initial_finding: get_order could commit its 24-hour order result, including order=null, after the request callback had observed cancellation. A later foreground get_order(fetch=True) would reuse that result instead of fetching.
findings_and_regressions.qualification: This establishes a commit after cancellation; a legitimately empty successful provider response is not by itself incorrect metadata.

findings_and_regressions.initial_finding: NavigationWarmer correctly rejected audio playback/modal state, but the same StartupPreloader iteration could still reach old catalogue, deferred hydration and pending-refresh paths. With isPlaying=true, isPlayingVideo=false and modal=true, the old gate returned true and dispatched RunPlugin plus Container.Refresh.
findings_and_regressions.scope_note: The existing idle pending-refresh behavior remains distinct from navigation warming. The new navigation warmer does not issue GUI refreshes.

findings_and_regressions.initial_finding: Three failed locale requests produced a truthy dictionary of None values. prepare accepted it as a season page, warm/tick returned true and applied a 3600-second success cooldown despite no valid season metadata.

urlsplit('plugin://[bad') raised ValueError before origin filtering. focused_target was called outside tick's work-body exception handler, so malformed focused item data could terminate the one service worker.

stopped[0] = stopped[0] or predicate() was not monotonic across threads because predicate calls can release the GIL. A slow eligible callback could overwrite cancellation already observed by another IO worker.
findings_and_regressions.deterministic_interleaving: Thread A reads old false and waits inside ready; thread B sees playback and records true; thread A resumes with its old eligible result; inspect a subsequent callback.

actual_nested_io_peak.derivation: Two related-movie searches plus two season tasks with three locale requests each.
actual_nested_io_peak.proof: Eight-party Barrier at mocked production tmdb_get boundaries reached peak 8; every call carried a budget and quiet=true.
actual_nested_io_peak.disposition: Main agent explicitly accepts this AM6B+ concurrency with resource headroom and cancellation. Do not describe the outer pool of 3 as a global IO cap.

request_budget_isolation: Concurrent normal search without a request scope succeeded with quiet=false and default remaining=12 while a separate cancelled worker failed only its own request.
The same worker performed a successful ordinary search after leaving its cancelled scope.
Nested deadlines use the smaller bound; quiet and cancellation combine; inner exceptions and outer exits restore prior context.
Shared TMDb session identity, default timeout and language were unchanged.
other_verified_properties.side_effect_scope: Reviewed warmer paths request account-neutral TMDb catalogue/detail metadata and write their intended caches. They read only public target IDs from focused/history item data. No playable-URL request, transfer creation, media-byte fetch, playback start, account modification or new-warmer GUI refresh was found in this reviewed call graph.

limits: The 8-second deadline is cooperative. Existing documentation correctly notes OS/platform DNS/connect cannot be forcibly interrupted by this code; executor exit waits for in-flight work.
Pure-memory fixtures cannot establish AM6B thermal behavior, memory usage, network latency, GUI smoothness or physical playback safety.
Source may change after the hashes below. These results cover the reviewed snapshot and exact counterexamples, not every conceivable input or later implementation.
The earlier Mushishi buffer investigation was paused when this review superseded it. No buffer probe, personal probe or device action was run.
